items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you have any recollection of Powell, Jr., and his dynamism in the community? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: The ensemble was interesting. It was a flute, soprano, a violin, piano, and then of course a big organ and the choir. So somebody was writing some music to go along with the services on Sunday.
Do you have any recollection of Powell, Jr., and his dynamism in the community?
